summary: Imports a glTF 2.0 .gltf or .glb scene into a generated TouchDesigner network with meshes, textures, PBR materials, cameras, lights, blend shapes, skeletons, and animation assets.

key_params.name: scene
key_params.note: Scene to import from the selected file

key_params.name: importmethod
key_params.note: Full Replacement, Merge with Existing, or Reload Assets

key_params.name: imp
key_params.note: Import assets and generate the internal network

key_params.name: quats
key_params.note: Import quaternion animation channels for smooth interpolation and accurate re-export

key_params.name: geocolorspace
key_params.note: Color space for imported mesh Color attributes

key_params.name: matcolorspace
key_params.note: Color space for generated PBR materials

key_params.name: keepparams
key_params.note: Preserve user parameter edits when merging imports

key_params.name: keepconnections
key_params.note: Preserve user wiring when merging imports

key_params.name: playmode
key_params.note: Timeline, index, sequential, or full-range animation playback

key_concepts: glTF In COMP supports glTF 2.0 .gltf and .glb files, not glTF 1.0.
Import first creates reusable mesh, texture, blend-shape, and animation assets, then generates a component hierarchy that follows the source scene.
Import Select POPs, TOPs, and CHOPs expose imported assets inside the generated network.
Quaternion animation channels improve interpolation and take priority over Euler channels when exporting through glTF Out COMP.
Merge with Existing and Reload Assets preserve more user work than Full Replacement when the source asset changes.
common_gotchas: Full Replacement clears and rebuilds the internal network, overwriting user-made changes.
Reload Assets is appropriate only when asset content changed without structural or hierarchy changes.
Auto Import reacts to supported parameter changes but does not detect a file being overwritten on disk.
Only one scene is imported per glTF In COMP; use multiple COMPs for multiple scenes.
For color-correct rendering, choose a project working color space and set geometry/material color-space parameters deliberately.
glTF In COMP does not load glTF files from TouchDesigner's Virtual File System.
